beats.title: Barn fight spills into rescue and escape
beats.summary: The recap opens with a multi-front battle around and inside the barn: Karsemine and Baergrom pressure cultists outside, while Stafl, Caelynn, Bonogo, Ephanna, and others are engaged in the barn. The beat includes Bonogo freeing goblin children, Caelynn and Stafl teleporting out, and Baergrom cutting through the barn wall to rescue Lysandra.

beats.title: Portal summon and escalating grapples
beats.summary: Fleshborn and the Dustwalker escalate the fight by opening portals/rips in space that spew tentacles, grabbing multiple targets and forcing movement around holes and barn doors. Several characters are restrained, the Dustwalker flees with Misty Step, and Stafl pursues him with Hideous Laughter while the fire continues to spread.

beats.title: Counterattacks break portals and free allies
beats.summary: The party responds with focused attacks: Ephanna and her Fey kill cultists and monsters, Caelynn destroys the portal holding her, and Karsemine and Baergrom work together to destroy another portal and free Baergrom. Meanwhile Bonogo, Lysandra, and others trade blows with monsters and the priest continues to assault Bonogo.
